Chapter 535: Chapter 23: Stepping into the Ninth Rank (End of the Volume, Please Subscribe)

“Illusory Reality” Inheritance Secret Technique could transform the essence of life.

It seemed that it did not greatly enhance combat power.

But one must know, Lin Yuan had two Primordial Spirit Avatars.

Since awakening various Divine Skills in Physical Body, he continuously absorbed the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd.

The gap between Lin Yuan’s True Body and the two major Primordial Spirits, Taiyang Divine Spirit and Taiyin Primordial Spirit, was widening.

The True Body could almost crush the Primordial Spirit Avatars.

...

Not to mention the Divine Skills in Physical Body, just the world within his body, spanning over a hundred million miles, was enough to outstrip the two major Primordial Spirits by several ranks.

The reason for all this was that the Primordial Spirits lacked flesh and blood and could not enjoy the enhancements from several Divine Skills of the Physical Body and the liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd.

One could foresee, this gap would only widen further in the future.

As the number of traversals increased, Lin Yuan would only have more Divine Skills in Physical Body and the last two types of liquid in the Mysterious Gourd, which would enhance his physical body and inner world.

But what if the two major Primordial Spirits transformed from beings of soul into beings of flesh and blood?

Once the two major Primordial Spirits transformed into beings of flesh and blood, they could share the ‘Blood Rebirth’ Divine Skill of Lin Yuan’s True Body, thereby absorbing the mysterious liquid in the gourd to enhance themselves.

In a strict sense, any major Primordial Spirit Avatar of Lin Yuan, once transformed into flesh and blood, would not be weaker than the True Body in terms of pure combat strength.

Of course, this refers to pure combat power, the True Body possessed many treasures and weapons, which gave it an advantage over the two major Primordial Spirits in this aspect.

Before becoming a core member of Moyu Tower, Lin Yuan too had considered this problem, seeking to enhance the combat power of the Primordial Spirit Avatars.

But there was basically no effect.

Many Evolvers of Human Civilization had the talent for mutual conversion between physical energy.

For example, in the tournament at Canglan Star, the top ten contender ‘Thunder God’, had the means to temporarily transform his physical body into thunder.

But that was the transformation of the physical body into energy, since the Evolvers of Human Civilization inherently possessed bodies of flesh and blood, they would only consider physical energy transformation.

Not energy-physical transformation.

Even so, the physical energy transformation had many dangers, lasting too shortly, and the stronger the physical body, the harder it was to transform into energy.

And the energy-physical transformation Lin Yuan wanted was more difficult, involving more essence.

Even with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, to start from scratch and derive a method for energy-physical transformation would likely take a ton of time. It was not something a life form at Lin Yuan’s level could touch upon.

But now.

The “Illusory Reality” Inheritance Secret Technique left by the Master of Moyu Tower was a perfect match for what Lin Yuan desired.

This secret technique allowed the physical body to switch between illusory and real at will, with no limitations or energy loss whatsoever.

This was simply…

Lin Yuan couldn’t even imagine how the Moyu Tower Master managed to achieve it.

From real to illusory, that was a complete transformation of life essence, switching between the two without any energy consumption? And to be able to do so at will without any restrictions?

“This is ‘Illusory Reality’.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji confirmed Lin Yuan’s choice and did not urge further.

In his view, even if Lin Yuan made the wrong choice, it wasn’t a big issue. With his talent and understanding, even without one of the Master’s inherited secret techniques, what could it really matter?

Buzz.

Stone Statue Shen Ji raised his hand, his index finger pointing at Lin Yuan’s forehead.

In an instant, Lin Yuan felt his consciousness falling, arriving in a boundless space.

In the center of the space, stood a greatly magnificent figure.

He was dressed in a black robe, his gaze indifferent, as if containing the rules of the Great Dao. Under Lin Yuan’s gaze, his figure faintly began to become illusory and similarly began to solidify back into reality.

Real to illusory.

Illusory to real.

Numerous details flooded into Lin Yuan’s mind.

[You have Against-Heaven’s Understanding, receiving mysterious information, deepening understanding of real-illusory transformation…]

…

[You have Against-Heaven’s Understanding, receiving mysterious information, deepening understanding of real-illusory transformation…]

…

[You have Against-Heaven’s Understanding, receiving mysterious information, deepening understanding of real-illusory transformation…]

…

“So that’s how it is.”

“To use this method for real-illusory transformation?”

“Amazing, the Moyu Tower Master really is incredible.”

On the Milky Way Main Star, Lin Yuan’s True Body opened his eyes, a smile appearing on his face.

The “Illusory Reality” Inheritance Secret Technique, unlike “Void Interpretation” that was recorded in text for later generations to study and learn.

It was directly infused into Lin Yuan’s mind, almost as if the Moyu Tower Master was personally teaching and guiding.

“No wonder becoming a core member of Moyu Tower, you get only one Inheritance Secret Technique. The cost of this method of inheritance is too high.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This method of imparting needed to split off a part of the soul essence to record this Inheritance Secret Technique, allowing for an empathetic effect.

Moreover, the recorded Inheritance Secret Technique had a limit on the number of times it could be imparted, and Lin Yuan even suspected that after the “Illusory Reality” was imparted to him, it might just disappear.

The Inheritance Secret Techniques at Stone Statue Shen Ji’s place would be reduced from seven to six.

“I have now more or less completely penetrated the ‘Illusory Reality’ Inheritance Secret Technique.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If “Void Interpretation” was also imparted in this manner, Lin Yuan guessed he could also instantly comprehend Complete Space Rules, instead of pondering for years before fully understanding them.

“For now, don’t transform the Primordial Spirit, first, comprehend the last bit of Fusion Rules… ”

Lin Yuan focused his thoughts, continuing to ponder on the Fusion Rules.

Transforming the Primordial Spirit into physical body, even with the help of the “Illusory Reality” Inheritance Secret Technique, would still take several days. Moreover, Lin Yuan was not sure if transforming the Primordial Spirit into the physical body would affect his breakthrough to the Ninth Rank.
